2: For the music director; with stringed instruments, on the Sheminith. A psalm of David. O Yahweh, do not rebuke me in your anger, and do not discipline me in your wrath.
3: Be gracious to me, O Yahweh, because I am feeble. Heal me, O Yahweh, for my bones are terrified.
4: My soul is also very terrified. But you, O Yahweh, how long?
5: Turn, O Yahweh; deliver my life. Save me for the sake of your steadfast love.
6: For there is no remembrance of you in death. In Sheol, who will give thanks to you?
7: I am weary with my groaning; ⌞I flood⌟ my bed every night. With my tears ⌞I drench⌟ my couch.
8: My eye wastes away because of vexation; it grows old because of all my oppressors.
9: Depart from me, all workers of evil, for Yahweh has heard the sound of my weeping.
10: Yahweh has heard my plea; Yahweh has accepted my prayer.
11: All my enemies shall be ashamed and shall be very terrified. They shall turn back; they shall suddenly be ashamed.
